android.desc:
Features:
	• Without ads
	• Puzzles can be downloaded from web, entered by hand or generated on the project's homepage
	• Game stats (time spent, mistakes)
	• Next step hints with multiple strategies suggestions
	• Import to and export from a file
	• Visual themes including custom theme editor
	• Several input modes (finger-friendly numpad, popup, keyboard etc.)
	• Double pencil marks
…and much more.

More information (including how to report ideas and issues) can be found on the project's home page: http://opensudoku.moire.org

quotes.text:
For anyone looking for a great open source Sudoku app with no ads: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.moire.opensudoku&gl=US

This looks great but I was sad to see advertisements and consider that a bell if not a whistle.  I would pay a few bucks for this if it could match the features of the above with this clean visual style.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Sudoku with 0 Bells or Whistles
